stories.title: Create an installable four-module launcher foundation
stories.want: an installable native project with verified tooling and explicit module boundaries
stories.benefit: later feature work starts from one reproducible build
readinessInputs: Approved project/design/ownership baseline; no Android implementation is implied.
Inherit F01 wave 1, exact lease, validation and coordinator handoff requirements; story completion alone does not accept the feature.
scope: Inspect workspace/local instructions and installed toolchain; record compatible pinned build versions and commands.
Scaffold exactly app, core:domain, core:data and core:designsystem with dev.handheld.launcher, manual AppContainer and explicit ViewModel factories.
Prepare Room runtime/testing, KSP, DataStore and schema-export dependencies; register an ordinary launchable Activity with minimal composable and acknowledged request-port attachment.
acceptanceFocus: A developer can build and normally launch the minimal Activity using the recorded tooling; Android 13/Flip 2 is the initial validation target and unrun physical checks remain pending.
Domain compiles without Android/Compose; design system imports no product module; app/data dependencies follow the approved direction.
Room processing/schema export and DataStore are configured before persistence consumers need them; SDK choices and machine-local paths are documented appropriately.
outOfScope: Feature screens, discovery and final default-HOME/window integration.
Additional modules, broad permissions or speculative frameworks.
stories.ownershipNotes: F01 initial-creation lease subset: root/module build files and manifests, MainActivity, DI skeleton and initial values resources; exact permitted paths stay those in F01. Sequence children with one active F01 writer; no new path permissions are granted.
sourceCoverage: F01 ordered step 5: normally launchable Activity and minimal composition (primary).

stories.title: Define stable catalog, persistence and launch contracts
stories.want: minimal shared contracts for item identity, catalog state and acknowledged launches
stories.benefit: data and feature implementations agree on preservation and recency behavior
readinessInputs: Approved project/design/ownership baseline; no Android implementation is implied.
Inherit F01 wave 1, exact lease, validation and coordinator handoff requirements; story completion alone does not accept the feature.
scope: Define domain item/component identities, availability, supported actions, category/provenance and observable catalog/favorite/preference boundaries.
Distinguish completed versus partial/failed inventory outcomes and document discovery fields separately from user data.
Define one-shot launch request/result acknowledgement, duplicate suppression and successful-open recording semantics; retain only generic ROM/provider extension boundaries.
acceptanceFocus: Two launchable components in one package remain distinct; rediscovery never replaces identity with title or filename.
Contract examples distinguish successful inventory from incomplete results and retain favorite/history references when availability changes.
Successful launcher dispatch can promote one existing item exactly once; failure, focus, details and internal system actions cannot promote it.
Fixtures specify deterministic successful-open order plus title/ID order for unopened items; no contract asserts a running process or records session duration.
outOfScope: Room entities/schema implementation and Android enumeration.
Speculative ROM/provider fields or compatibility promises.
stories.ownershipNotes: F01 initial-creation lease subset: domain model/repository/policy contracts, matching domain tests and their contracts.md entries. Sequence children with one active F01 writer; no new path permissions are granted.
sourceCoverage: F01 ordered step 6: deterministic domain fixtures (primary).

stories.title: Publish shared navigation, input and presentation ports
stories.want: typed app-facing ports and fixtures before shell and feature consumers begin
stories.benefit: all pages use the same actions, restoration keys and platform requests
readinessInputs: Approved project/design/ownership baseline; no Android implementation is implied.
Inherit F01 wave 1, exact lease, validation and coordinator handoff requirements; story completion alone does not accept the feature.
scope: Define six fixed destination IDs, details/shortcut Search origins, per-destination identity/anchor/query/filter/sort snapshots and shell action/footer descriptors.
Define semantic input actions, persisted confirm/back preference with A-confirm/B-back default, dispatch precedence and presentation-only modal lifecycle callbacks.
Define acknowledged Activity requests, truthful status presentation and shared item-to-card/launch/navigation boundaries; provide deterministic app fixtures and publish contracts/path leases.
acceptanceFocus: A fixture can express dock-to-Home Back, shortcut Search origin return and item-details origin without storing a Compose object or a whole list.
The same typed action descriptor can drive a footer prompt and semantic dispatch; persisted mapping defaults are explicit.
Modal lifecycle callbacks can be implemented in the independent design system without importing app/domain; status fixtures distinguish unavailable from unsupported.
Repeated observation of an acknowledged Activity request does not request another launch/role prompt; accepted interfaces and ownership are published before F02/F06 begin.
outOfScope: Concrete shell navigation, input processing or preference encoding.
Live telemetry or production sample content.
stories.ownershipNotes: F01 initial-creation lease subset: app contract types, Activity request-port definition, contract fixtures/tests and contracts.md; coordinator retains publication/baseline responsibility. Sequence children with one active F01 writer; no new path permissions are granted.
sourceCoverage: F01 ordered step 5: acknowledged Activity request port (primary).
F01 ordered step 6: app test/debug fixtures (primary).
F01 ordered step 7 and validation/handoff publication (primary).

stories.title: Express Home's visual language as a shared native theme

stories.benefit: screens share one visual language without duplicating literal styling

Implement LauncherTheme colors, typography, spacing, shapes, depth and motion with one gradient recipe.
Bundle Plus Jakarta Sans and required notice; start heavy style at explicit weight 800 and support font scaling.

Consumers can select semantic colors/type/spacing rather than repeat visual literals; essential text remains readable after compositing.
Font assets work offline with the required notice; system font scaling and reduced-motion intent are respected rather than defeated by fixed bitmap scaling.
outOfScope: Shell composition, live data and final device-calibrated dp/sp values.
Direct copying of CSS units into Android dimensions.
stories.ownershipNotes: F02 one-time creation lease subset: theme files, font resources/notices and evidence; later token changes require coordinator integration. Sequence children with one active F02 writer; no new path permissions are granted.

Focused outlines/lift fit reserved bounds; square artwork and usable controls survive compact or larger-font scenarios.
Reference proportions guide initial geometry without being presented as verified native constants; physical Flip 2 calibration remains explicit.

Invented performance or device-fidelity claims.

stories.benefit: later controls share predictable semantics and focus visuals

acceptanceFocus: Actual focus has one immediate visible treatment independent from a selected destination/filter; decorative motion does not delay focus feedback.
Text/icon primitives expose meaningful semantics while decorative elements avoid misleading focus targets.
Long text and unavailable values remain readable; supported touch targets can reach 48dp without overlapping adjacent targets.
Representative primitives render without repositories/sensors or product-module imports and the initial API inventory includes unresolved calibration evidence.
outOfScope: Product cards, shell navigation and sensor readings.
Tests that simply restate token constants.

sourceCoverage: F02 ordered step 5: primitive state/text previews (primary).

stories.benefit: destinations expose consistent controller and touch interactions

A selected chip stays selected while another chip receives the amber focus treatment.
Unavailable controls expose the reason/recovery semantics appropriate to the supplied state; disabled activation produces no action.
SearchField delegates editing to the native IME and contains no navigation, repository or ViewModel lookup.

A custom keyboard or app-specific control dependencies.

stories.benefit: content changes keep the same readable layout and focus behavior

acceptanceFocus: Pending, absent and failed artwork replace only content inside unchanged image/card bounds and preserve the accessible item name.
Home/collection/app variants share activation/focus semantics; different icon shapes fit while cover images remain unstretched.
Long captions obey bounded lines/ellipsis without changing tile height; status available/unavailable/unsupported variants remain honest.
Cards receive presentation and callbacks without deciding catalog type, emulator, navigation or image data source.
outOfScope: Domain-to-card mapping, artwork fetching or per-page duplicate cards.
Running badges and fake telemetry.

Examples distinguish active destination from controller focus and selected chip from focused chip.
Home reorder, large labels/counts, different icon shapes, failed art and IME-constrained layouts can be reviewed with stable dimensions.
Evidence records clipping/readability issues and pending physical calibration rather than declaring untested device fidelity.

Search entered through a shortcut and details/dialogs retain their initiating origin; dismissing them returns to that origin.
Selecting a dock destination does not claim controller focus is on that destination.
Each fixture destination keeps independent keys and real features can register through one published route boundary.

stories.ownershipNotes: F04 initial-creation lease subset: navigation except restoration, dock route hooks and matching evidence/tests; registry is reserved after acceptance. Sequence children with one active F04 writer; no new path permissions are granted.

Returning to normal layout restores common Home-derived anchors without per-page compensations.
Transient bar/state fixtures retain navigation keys and a valid content surface.
Reference comparison excludes editor surroundings and explicitly records unverified physical density/keyboard behavior.

stories.ownershipNotes: F04 initial-creation lease subset: shell layout/insets policy, navigation attachment documentation and evidence; coordinator wires gallery and later Activity window behavior. Sequence children with one active F04 writer; no new path permissions are granted.

Mapping preference changes actual confirm/back actions and displayed glyphs together, with A-confirm/B-back as default.
IME consumes Back before dialogs/details/origin handling; root Home stays open; typing does not leak shell shortcuts.
Only applicable X/Y/Start/filter actions run, and all input handling stops at the launcher boundary.
